newsitem.title: USA: Kimberly-Clark grows in Euro diaper market.
newsitem.headline: Kimberly-Clark grows in Euro diaper market.

text.p: Kimberly-Clark Corp said Friday that it has launched Huggies diapers in Poland and will increase production capacity at its diaper plant in Barton-upon-Humber, England, to meet growing demand for Huggies diapers in Europe.
Since 1995, the company has introduced its diapers, tissue and other products in 18 countries in the region and established sales offices in Russia, Poland and the Czech Republic.

In a press release, Kimberly-Clark said this latest capacity addition, combined with an expansion project already under way at Barton, will increase production at the facility by more than 50 percent when the new equipment starts up in the first half of 1998.

"In slightly more than three years, Kimberly-Clark has gone from having no presence in the European diaper market to being the number two diaper producer," said John Van Steenberg, president of Kimberly-Clarke Europe.

"In the Western European markets in which we sell Huggies diapers, the brand's share has nearly doubled from just under 10 percent in 1995 to 18 percent in 1996. Including other brands such as Monbebe and Peaudouce, our total share of the Western European diaper market is currently 24 percent."
The company said it estimated the diaper market in Poland, which it values at around $110 million, to be growing at 10 percent a year.
Kimberly-Clark's businesses in Europe account for nearly $3 billion of the company's $13.1 billion in consolidated sales.
